outputs.Decision_and_explanation: FAIL: The top box plot ('Total polyp number per mouse') shows box-and-whisker elements, but the caption only states the mean numbers/sizes of polyps and significance thresholds (*P<0.05; ***P<0.001) without defining what the box, median line, or whiskers represent (e.g., IQR, min-max, percentiles).

FAIL: The 'GTP-bound form' bar graph shows an error bar on at least one bar, but the caption only describes the pulldown assay methodology and does not state what the error bar represents (e.g., SD, SEM, n replicates).
FAIL: The 'Relative expression' bar graph shows error bars with significance asterisks, but the caption does not state what the error bars represent (e.g., SD, SEM) or the number of replicates.
